From: Oliver Hayes <oliver@vertexlabs.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quickstart signup — exploring dedicated inference for recommendation model

Hi Hannah,

I filled out the Quickstart docs CTA yesterday — thanks for the great walkthroughs. We're evaluating Redwood to replace our current inference stack for a recommendation model (heavy KV cache usage, long sequences).

Would appreciate a technical walkthrough focused on production performance, quantization tradeoffs, and Dedicated deployment options. I'm on PT (PST) and can do early mornings next week.

Quick summary:
- Company: Vertex Labs (seed-stage)
- Use case: real-time recommendations, 100–200 qps, 1–1.5s latency SLO
- Current infra: mixed cloud GPUs + caching layer

Thanks —
Oliver Hayes
Lead ML Engineer, Vertex Labs
oliver@vertexlabs.ai

Hi Oliver — great to meet you over email, and really glad the docs were useful. I’m Hannah on the SDR team and I’ll set up a short technical walkthrough with an engineer so we can cover throughput/latency, batching, and Dedicated options.

Two asks from me now:
1) Quick availability — do mornings (PST) next Tue/Wed/Thu work?
2) Any specific benchmarks or prompt sets you'd like us to run in the session? If so, drop a link and I’ll forward to engineering.

I’ve CC’d Ben (pre-sales) so he’s looped for pricing/throughput discussion. If it's helpful, we can also include Camila from infra to talk runtime/quantization.

I'll propose two tentative 30-min slots on Calendly and we can pivot — here is my booking link: https://calendly.com/hannah-s/redwood-tech-30

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
